derivation: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6996 (קָטָן));
def: to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account
kjv: be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.

words.word: i am not worthy of the least
and this was yet a small thing
and yet this was a small thing

occurrences.text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
words: I am not worthy of the least

occurrences.text: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord God; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord God?
words: And this was yet a small thing

occurrences.text: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
words: And yet this was a small thing

occurrences.text: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
